name: Niijima Izumi
source:
A kind, charming woman with a warm and gentle demeanor. She's good at talking with and listening to others, and she can make someone feel at ease just by being with her and can make men desire her attention and care. 

Her body which feels good to embrace, together with her devoted service is known to soothe her customers physically and mentally.

[Translated and slightly edited from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/hitotsumami/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
